newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: SNORAS, POST OFFICE SIGN COOPERATION DEAL.
newsitem.headline: SNORAS, POST OFFICE SIGN COOPERATION DEAL.

text.p: Snoras Bank has signed a deal with the Lithuanian post office to allow it to offer banking services at post office branches.
Aleksandr Chernov, deputy chairman of Snoras Bank, told reporters late on Monday that the bank hoped to have some machines up and running, first in Vilnius, by the end of July.
He said there would be 60 machines serving debit card holders in post office branches throughout the country by the end of the year.
Next year, Snoras plans to have 200 terminals operating in post offices and 300 in 1999.
The agreement is for three years with an option to extend. Chernov said the services Snoras will offer to post office customers will depend on how well the first stage goes.
